title: Transfer of RNA from Agarose Gels onto Membranes
author: Jonathan Houseley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnsymefw

steps.title: Prepare membranes and Whatman paper
steps.instruction: Cut the required pieces of nylon membrane and Whatman paper and mark the membrane for orientation.

substeps.instruction: Cut one 15 × 15 cm piece of nylon membrane.
Cut two 15 × 15 cm pieces of Whatman paper.
Cut one 15 × 46 cm piece of Whatman paper.
Cut a corner of the nylon membrane and label it with pencil on the same side as the RNA.

steps.title: Pre-soak materials
steps.instruction: Soak the 15 × 15 cm Whatman paper and the nylon membrane in 6× SSC in a plastic box.

steps.title: Assemble transfer apparatus base
steps.instruction: Set up the reservoir and support for the blotting sandwich.

substeps.instruction: Fill a box with 6× SSC to a depth of approximately 2 cm.
Place a glass plate over the top, leaving a gap to allow Whatman paper to reach the 6× SSC.
Wet the 15 × 46 cm strip of Whatman paper with 6× SSC and place it over the plate so both ends are in the 6× SSC reservoir.

steps.title: Assemble the gel sandwich
steps.instruction: Layer the gel, membrane, and paper to facilitate RNA transfer.

substeps.instruction: Carefully flip the gel and place it onto the Whatman paper with the wells facing down.
Place the wetted nylon membrane over the gel, using the cut corner to track orientation, ensuring there are no dry patches.
Place the two 15 × 15 cm square pieces of Whatman paper on top of the membrane.
Roll a Stripette over the sandwich to remove all air bubbles.

steps.title: Secure and weight the apparatus
steps.instruction: Prevent short-circuiting and apply pressure to the sandwich for overnight transfer.

substeps.instruction: Place two strips of Parafilm over the ends of the long Whatman paper strip not covered by the gel.
Place two stacks of paper towel, approximately 5 cm high, next to each other over the sandwich.
Place another glass plate on top.
Leave the transfer apparatus overnight.

steps.title: Cross-link the RNA
steps.instruction: Irradiate the membrane to fix the RNA using UV light.

substeps.instruction: Pick up the two square Whatman papers and the membrane together and place them on the cross-linker floor with the RNA side facing upward.
Ensure the paper and membrane are lightly damp (not dripping or dry).
Irradiate using Auto-crosslink mode for a Stratalinker or 120,000 μJ/cm² for other cross-linkers.

steps.title: Store the membrane
steps.instruction: Wrap the membrane in cling film for storage.

substeps.instruction: Store at Room temperature for probing on the same day.
Store at -20 °C for long-term storage.
